# PERPLEXTA Platform

> PERPLEXTA is a sovereign multimodal AI ecosystem combining live full-stack application generation, Rinex 4K design and motion graphics studio, ViralBook interactive advertising & social ecosystem, Viral TopUp financial wallet services, academic research engine, and creator economy platform.

## Core Capabilities
- [PERPLEXTA App Studio](https://perplexta.com/app): Interactive full-stack application generator with real-time preview, instant code editing, and sovereign deployment.
- [Rinex Studio](https://perplexta.com/image-studio): Freeform canvas, motion graphics, vector editing, 4K video exports, and certified marketplace templates powered by the Rinex engine.
- [Academic Research & AI Chat](https://perplexta.com/chat): AI-powered academic paper synthesis, verified citations, and research literature analysis.
- [ViralBook](https://perplexta.com/viralbook): Sovereign advertising ecosystem, creator feed, verified reels, business pages, and interactive social community.
- [Viral TopUp & Subscriptions](https://perplexta.com/subscription): Transparent daily, monthly, and developer tiers with ledger-backed Viral TopUp financial services and wallet credits.
- [Creator Economy](https://perplexta.com/creator): Creator partner program with verified templates, revenue sharing ($0.70/use + 20% recurring), and Viral TopUp wallet payouts.
- [Terms of Service](https://perplexta.com/terms): Sovereign IP ownership, privacy guarantees, and usage policies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://perplexta.com/privacy): Strict data encryption, user data ownership, and zero-retention policies.
- [Documentation Index](https://perplexta.com/docs/legal): Governance manuals, financial ledger protocols, and technical architecture docs.

## Agent Resources & APIs
- [WebMCP Endpoint](https://perplexta.com/api/mcp/sse): Server-Sent Events stream implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for autonomous AI agents.
- [System Sitemap](https://perplexta.com/sitemap.xml): Full platform URL structure and index.
- [Robots Policy](https://perplexta.com/robots.txt): Crawler rules and accessibility boundaries.
- [Web App Manifest](https://perplexta.com/manifest.json): Progressive Web App configuration and install metadata.
